item.title: Tucker residents to provide feedback on Whataburger plans for Hugh Howell Road
item.description: MTOH is planning to open a Whataburger on Hugh Howell Road in Tucker, and is seeking feedback from residents at a public participation meeting on Feb. 24. item.title: Taste of Atlanta turns 25 with chefs who helped build city’s food scene
item.description: Taste of Atlanta, founded in 2001, will celebrate its 25th anniversary on April 16 with a "Culinary Icons Reunion" featuring Atlanta chefs, restaurateurs, and restaurant regulars who have shaped the city's food scene over the last 25 years.
